Q6111.reason: A general litter ordinance is a content-neutral O'Brien rule that protects park cleanliness and only incidentally limits the expressive dumping.

Q5735.reason: Only a defendant may remove, so the plaintiff's removal was ineffective and the defendant's timely remand motion returns the entire case.

Q5651.reason: Advertising the car as a 1964 creates an express warranty of description that remains in force alongside an as-is clause under UCC 2-316.
